title: Patio Racket
style: electro folk, dholak, japanese instruments, fast-tempo, romantica
lyrics: 🎤 VERSE 1 (Corey)Hey there, Michelle, it’s your Song Pal line! 📬Dropping a track to say you're doing just fine.I’m sending this letter just to let you know,You’re a superstar wife and the star of the show!From the heart of the family, the ultimate cool,Making your own lane, breaking every rule. 🕶️🎤 VERSE 2 (Michelle)(Upbeat, swaying rhythm)You got the message, Corey, thanks for the call!Right out on the patio playing some balls.I’m tending the garden and digging the dirt,With a racket in hand in my comfortable shirt. 🏓🎤 CHORUS (Corey & Michelle)Oh, Michelle! The coolest around! 🌟Best in the family, the truest we've found!With a racket in your hand or a plant in the land,You’re rocking your world just exactly as planned!Yeah, we all want to say you’re the star of the show,Our favorite Song Pal, just thought you should know! 🎤🎤 VERSE 3 (Wesley & Ruby)(High energy, clapping rhythm)Mom is the champion, out on the court! 🏆Pickleball queen, she loves the sport!Wesley and Ruby are cheering her name,Watching our awesome mom win every game!Out in the garden, making everything green, 🌿The prettiest backyard that we’ve ever seen!🎤 VERSE 4 (Corey)Then you hit the court, and the competition falls,Ruling the baseline, crushing pickleball! 🥒Serving up aces, then watering the seeds,You’re exactly the hype that this whole family needs!🎤 OUTRO (Corey, Michelle, Wesley & Ruby)So here’s a little replay from your pen pal crew,A special delivery dedicated to you!Keep being awesome, keep shining so bright,Corey and the kids say you’re doing it right!🎸 Guitar fades out with a cheerful whistle 🎶
